landing.heroBadge: National Verified Artisan Cooperative · Zero Markups
landing.heroDesc: Certified technicians and master craftsmen dispatched directly to your doorstep. Transparent quantile pricing, live road routing, and fair cooperative wages.
landing.spotlightPriceNote: Guaranteed fair quantile pricing · Standard rates start at ₹350
landing.pillar1Desc: Biometric Aadhaar authentication & cooperative skill scrutiny for every technician.
landing.pillar2Desc: Cooperative governance ensures artisans retain 95%+ of your customer payment.
landing.pillar3Desc: High-precision open-source road routing with direct dispatch navigation.
landing.pillar4Desc: Funds are safely held in digital escrow and released immediately upon job satisfaction.
landing.signatureDesc: Dispatched in under 30 minutes. Every technician is fully vetted, equipped with proper diagnostic tools, and bound by cooperative pricing guarantees.
landing.signaturePoint1: Fixed upfront pricing with no hidden charges
landing.signaturePoint2: Real-time OSRM route tracking directly to your gate
landing.signaturePoint3: Funds protected in digital escrow until inspection
landing.trade1Desc: Wiring, switchboard faults, MCBs, inverter & short-circuit repair
landing.trade2Desc: Leak detection, pipeline fixes, tap replacement & sanitary fittings
landing.trade3Desc: Door latches, furniture repair, hinge replacement & custom woodwork
landing.whyDesc: A sustainable national labor network engineered to end wage exploitation while delivering peerless craftsmanship to Indian households.
landing.why1Desc: Unlike corporate apps charging 25-30% cuts, Shramik operates as a worker-owned cooperative where proceeds support worker pensions and community welfare.
landing.why2Desc: Every technician passes ITI certification checks or comprehensive practical trade assessments before taking on live household calls.
landing.why3Desc: No surge pricing algorithms. We publish statistical p25, p50, and p75 rate benchmarks so you always know what a fair market cost is.
landing.why4Desc: Your payment is safeguarded in escrow and only released when the job is completed to your satisfaction, backed by cooperative mediation.
landing.howTitle: How to book a verified artisan
landing.howDesc: Three simple, transparent steps without complex negotiations or hidden charges.
landing.step1Desc: Describe your repair issue by voice in Hindi, Marathi, or English, or choose directly from our trade catalog.
landing.step2Desc: Our dispatch algorithm assigns the nearest verified artisan with turn-by-turn OSRM road routing and clear ETA.
landing.step3Desc: Inspect the completed work, verify the digital OTP, and release payment directly into the technician's account.
landing.bannerTitle: Are you a skilled technician or craftsman?
landing.bannerDesc: Keep 95%+ of your customer earnings. Enjoy cooperative dividend distributions, tool loan assistance, and direct transparent job assignments in your pin code.
landing.feedbackTitle: Trusted by citizens and technicians alike
landing.feedbackDesc: Read how our cooperative model transforms local repairs across Indian cities.
landing.hubsDesc: Expanding across Tier-1 and Tier-2 regions with certified local artisan cooperatives.

footer.desc: Empowering local technicians through cooperative gig services with fair commissions, social security, and transparent governance.
